separationFromSimulation: Nothing in src/chaos/** is imported by src/v3/**. Draft Value decides how OFTEN a card is offered, never how it performs. A regression test asserts the import boundary.

components.positionTalent: Best position-relative percentile of slotRating among cards eligible at that position.
components.versatility: Positional flexibility, two-way breadth, and off-ball scalability (value that survives a usage cut).
components.scarcity: Whether the card supplies a capability the pool rarely has, measured from the pool rather than hardcoded.
